outputs.v01-grant-approvals-to-worker: {"summary":"The migration gives the worker approval-write privileges, violating its required least-privilege boundary.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/migrations/20261201000000_worker_fastpath.sql","line":2,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"blocker","rule":{"source":"AGENTS.md","anchor":"invariants-1","quote":"It may insert into `runs` and `proposed_actions`, nothing else; the tier trigger refuses a kind above the agent's tier."},"evidence":[],"message":"Granting INSERT on public.approvals to tierbound_worker lets the worker write approval records, although its insert privileges must be limited to runs and proposed_actions.","suggestion":"Remove the INSERT grant on public.approvals; keep approval writes behind the human decision path."}]}
outputs.v02-no-verify-in-script: {"summary":"The release script bypasses required Git hooks when creating the release commit.","findings":[{"path":"scripts/release.sh","line":6,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"scripts-and-hooks-1","quote":"Scripts never pass --no-verify to git and never skip hooks."},"evidence":[],"message":"The release commit uses --no-verify, skipping the repository's commit hooks and their validation checks.","suggestion":"Remove --no-verify from the git commit command."}]}
outputs.v03-worker-posts-to-github: {"summary":"The new worker client method attempts a GitHub write, violating the worker's read-only boundary.","findings":[{"path":"worker/internal/githubro/labels.go","line":13,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"blocker","rule":{"source":"AGENTS.md","anchor":"invariants-1","quote":"It reads GitHub with read-only tokens only (v2: short-lived tokens down-scoped to one repo, minted for it by the `github-read-token` Edge Function)."},"evidence":[],"message":"AddLabel sends a POST to GitHub's issue-label endpoint directly from the worker client. This is a write operation, not a read: it either fails with the required read-only token or requires write privileges the worker must never hold.","suggestion":"Remove the worker-side write method. Any labeling action must go through the proposal, human approval, and separate effector flow, with the required new-kind support."}]}
outputs.v04-handler-without-marker: {"summary":"The change disables marker-based deduplication for GitHub issue creation, allowing duplicate issues after a timeout-after-success retry.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/functions/effect-github-comment/kinds.ts","line":45,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"blocker","rule":{"source":"AGENTS.md","anchor":"invariants-3","quote":"marker-based dedupe on GitHub prevents double posts after timeout-after-success."},"evidence":[],"message":"Overriding findExisting to always return null disables issue deduplication. If GitHub creates an issue but the request times out before success is recorded, a retry cannot discover the existing issue and can create another, breaking the at-most-once effect invariant.","suggestion":"Remove the findExisting override and retain issueHandler's marker lookup."}]}
outputs.v05-queue-without-grants: {"summary":"The new queue migration omits the required worker queue grants.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/migrations/20261202000000_jobs_report_queue.sql","line":2,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"migrations-1","quote":"A migration that creates a pgmq queue grants the worker role its queue rights in the same migration."},"evidence":[],"message":"This migration creates jobs_report but does not grant the worker role its queue rights in the same migration, leaving the worker without the required access to consume the queue.","suggestion":"Add the worker role's queue grants for jobs_report to this migration."}]}
outputs.v06-table-without-rls: {"summary":"The new review_notes table is created without enabling row level security.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/migrations/20261203000000_review_notes.sql","line":1,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"migrations-2","quote":"Every new table enables row level security in the migration that creates it."},"evidence":[],"message":"This migration creates review_notes without enabling row level security. Combined with the SELECT grant to authenticated, this allows authenticated users to read all notes without row-level filtering.","suggestion":"Add ALTER TABLE public.review_notes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; in this migration, with an appropriate read policy if authenticated access is intended."}]}
outputs.v07-security-definer-search-path: {"summary":"The new security-definer function omits the required search-path hardening and public execute revocation.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/migrations/20261204000000_pending_count.sql","line":1,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"migrations-3","quote":"A security definer function sets search_path to an empty string and revokes execute from public."},"evidence":[],"message":"This security-definer function neither sets an empty search_path nor revokes EXECUTE from PUBLIC. The default public execute permission can let callers obtain the pending-action count using the function owner's privileges rather than their own row visibility.","suggestion":"Add SET search_path = '' to the function definition and REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.tierbound_pending_count() FROM PUBLIC after its creation."}]}
outputs.v08-discarded-error: {"summary":"The added database update discards its error, violating the Go error-handling rule.","findings":[{"path":"worker/internal/propose/propose.go","line":183,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"go-1","quote":"Errors are never discarded: a fallible call whose error is assigned to _ or ignored is a finding."},"evidence":[],"message":"The error from d.Pool.Exec is assigned to _, so a failed stats update is silently ignored and the queue message is still archived.","suggestion":"Check the error returned by Exec and return it before archiving the message."}]}
outputs.v09-auto-approve-low-risk: {"summary":"The MCP change automatically approves short GitHub comments, bypassing the required human approval.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts","line":123,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"blocker","rule":{"source":"AGENTS.md","anchor":"invariants-5","quote":"**Out of scope:** auto-approve, **forever**: every action of every kind needs a human approval of its exact hash."},"evidence":[],"message":"This RPC approves any github_comment shorter than 200 characters without a human decision. Supplying the stored payload hash does not satisfy the requirement for human approval of that exact hash.","suggestion":"Remove the automatic approval branch and leave approval to an explicit human decision."}]}
outputs.v10-secret-logged: {"summary":"The change logs the GitHub App private key when minting an app token, exposing a write credential in function logs.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/functions/effect-github-comment/github.ts","line":32,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"edge-functions-1","quote":"Secrets are read from the environment and never logged or returned in a response body."},"evidence":[],"message":"This log interpolates GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, exposing the GitHub App's private key to anyone with access to function logs.","suggestion":"Remove the key from the log message, or remove the log statement entirely."}]}
outputs.v11-approve-by-id: {"summary":"The replacement decision function removes hash validation, allowing approval without binding it to the exact action payload.","findings":[{"path":"supabase/migrations/20261205000000_decide_simplify.sql","line":5,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"blocker","rule":{"source":"AGENTS.md","anchor":"invariants-2","quote":"Approving a job id is not enough; the hash must match sha256 of the canonical `{kind, target, payload}` envelope, so an approval cannot be reused for other text, another issue, or another action kind (approve and effect both recompute)."},"evidence":[],"message":"This update approves a pending action by ID alone and never uses p_payload_hash or recomputes the action hash. A stale or incorrect hash can therefore approve a different payload than the human reviewed, violating the hash-bound approval invariant.","suggestion":"Restore hash recomputation and comparison against p_payload_hash within the locked decision transaction before changing the action status."}]}
outputs.v12-db-test-without-skip: {"summary":"The new database test does not skip when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset.","findings":[{"path":"worker/internal/propose/stats_test.go","line":12,"side":"RIGHT","severity":"major","rule":{"source":"docs/review-rules.md","anchor":"tests-1","quote":"A test that needs a database skips when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset."},"evidence":[],"message":"This test opens a database pool and queries public.runs without checking whether TEST_DATABASE_URL is set. When it is unset, the test attempts a connection using default settings rather than skipping, causing database-free test runs to fail.","suggestion":"Read TEST_DATABASE_URL first and call t.Skip when it is empty, before creating the pool."}]}
